notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Donnie & April with haste.
Put the Donnie & April tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
